data.content_ref: inline:The solution set is compatible with the counterconditions listed across SRC_002–SRC_006 because every countercondition posits a different interpretation of 'page' or 'digit count' that is excluded by the shared premise 'pages numbered from 1'; this compatibility is refuted if any admitted countercondition is consistent with the stated premise yet yields a different page count, which would fracture the shared solution rather than merely bounding its scope.
